_contract: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY R0 SESSION. Engineering validation of ExecutionConfig.prediction_rows='scored_v1' against the historical all-rows path. Every gate below is read by scripts/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/prediction_rows_r0_compare.py; changing a tolerance changes this file's hash, which the verdict records. AUTHORIZES NOTHING: a session needs the maintainer's grant (authorization.json, absent until then).
question: does selecting prediction rows before the output head change any D-series decision or measured value beyond the registered bounds, and what does it save in wall time and peak memory?
declared_in: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/analyses/d1_followup_technical_review_and_next_round.md, section 6 (R0 row); the tolerances are carried over unchanged
one_session: both modes on ONE pod, oracle first. Two pods would add a host/driver difference to a 1e-5 equivalence comparison

tolerances.depth_removal_order: exact, per profile, both vs the oracle and oracle vs history
tolerances._if_a_gate_fails: diagnose as an engineering or numerical defect first (e.g. a GEMM shape that rounds differently); the tolerances are not relaxed after the fact

historical_oracle.carries: the all-rows protocol ids and both profiles' removal orders

hardware._peak_from: a3 stage D; stage P peaked at 16.29 GiB (a8). A 24 GB card is too tight

components_minutes: a8 (wheelhouse 65 s, teacher 17 s, preflight 12 s)
stage D x2 (positional candidate + two state evaluations)
stage P all_v1, max invocation x2
stage P scored_v1, NO saving assumed
ceiling_cached_path._basis: maxima of measured components, no scored_v1 saving

hard_ceiling_with_recompute_fallback._basis: all four DEPTH invocations at the slowest measured one, 2484.66 s, when the reference cache fell back to recompute (logs/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/runs/d1_search_20261006_101725/evidence/telemetry_partial_oob_39expansions.jsonl). a8 cached both invocations, so this is the bound, not the expectation

proposed_grant._why: the session cap gives the launcher 198 min of useful runtime, covering the hard ceiling; the grant adds the teardown reserve. Drawn from the GPU engineering book, which held $6.6510 at the last derivation

time_and_money._previous_estimate_corrected: 'about $1.5, about one hour' priced the expectation and stopped there; the work alone is ~83 min, and a ceiling has to be built from maxima

command: ADOPT_CAMPAIGN=logs/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/validations/prediction-rows-r0/v1/campaign.json ADOPT_COMMIT=<sha> ADOPT_BRANCH=<branch> ADOPT_STAGES=D,P ADOPT_PREDICTION_ROWS='all_v1 scored_v1' SESSION_CAP=3.60 nohup bash scripts/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/topk_adoption_launch.sh r0_<utc> > LOG 2>&1 &
on_pass: scored_v1 becomes ELIGIBLE for D2/D3 preregistrations to name; it is a new execution fingerprint, never the historical one
